verdict.rationale: Datadog Monitors (datadog-docs-10) let users define threshold/anomaly rules that trigger notifications, and Watchdog (datadog-docs-16) provides automated anomaly detection, giving some rule-based automation on events. However, the evidence pack lacks documentation of a dedicated workflow/automation-action engine (e.g., automated remediation, webhooks-to-action pipelines) that would fully satisfy 'trigger actions automatically,' so the story is only partially covered. Missing for 10: explicit docs on Workflow Automation or action-execution engine, and independent confirmation that triggered actions (not just alerts) run automatically.
